name: Waller Gethin

intro.text: A wall is two faces leaning in, tied across with throughstones, filled with the little ones. Same as a good team. Shall we see?

win: Nicely placed. You'd make a decent waller. Hard on the knees, mind.
after: Never throw a stone back that you've picked up. Pick it up once, put it in its place. That's the first rule. The second is: don't lean on the wall. The third is also: don't lean on the wall.
